Chairman McKay seconded the motion and it carried by unanimous vote, Supervisor Alcorn, Supervisor Bierman, Supervisor Herrity, Supervisor Jimenez, Supervisor Lusk, Supervisor Palchik, Supervisor Sizemore Heizer, Supervisor Smith, Supervisor Storck, and Chairman McKay voting “AYE.”
decisions.tally: Carried by unanimous vote, Supervisor Alcorn, Supervisor Bierman, Supervisor Herrity, Supervisor Jimenez, Supervisor Lusk, Supervisor Palchik, Supervisor Sizemore Heizer, Supervisor Smith, Supervisor Storck, and Chairman McKay voting “AYE.”

That will permit persons who wish to testify on this matter to do so during the public hearing on the Fiscal Year 2027 Advertised Budget Plan, Capital Improvement Plan, and FY 2026 Third Quarter Review by testifying as described on the Department of Clerk Services page on the Fairfax County website or by providing written testimony after the close of the public hearings. Supervisor Palchik seconded the motion and it carried by unanimous vote.

decisions.item: 4. Presentation Honoring Members of the Fairfax County Police Department (FCPD) for Their Service During the January 6, 2021, Incident
decisions.action: Chairman McKay relinquished the Chair to Vice-Chairman Smith and moved approval of the Resolution of Recognition honoring members of the FCPD, including officers in the Civil Disturbance Unit (CDU), for their service, courage, and commitment to duty on January 6, 2021, while supporting fellow law enforcement officers to defend and secure the United States Capitol. The motion was multiply seconded. Following discussion regarding the contributions of the officers involved, lasting impacts, and personal sacrifice, the question was called on the motion and it carried by unanimous vote.

decisions.item: 5. Board Organization and Appointments to Various Regional and Internal Boards and Committees

decisions.item: 6. Appointments to Citizen Boards, Authorities, Commissions, and Advisory Groups (BACS)
decisions.action: Supervisor Smith moved approval of the appointments and reappointments of those individuals identified in the final copy of “Appointments to be Heard January 13, 2026.” The motion was multiply seconded and carried by unanimous vote.

decisions.item: 16. Naming of Bridge on Route 193 Over Difficult Run for John J. Adams

Adams. Chairman McKay seconded the motion and it carried by unanimous vote.

decisions.item: 21. Environmental Quality Advisory Council (EQAC) 2025 Annual Report on the Environment

decisions.item: 39. Request for an Opinion From the Virginia Attorney General Regarding Acceptance of a Street Into the Secondary System of Highways

decisions.item: 48. 4:30 P.m. – Public Hearing to Consider an Ordinance Expanding the West Springfield Residential Permit Parking District (RPPD), District 7 (BRADDOCK District)
decisions.action: Chairman McKay relinquished the Chair to Vice-Chairman Smith and moved adoption of the proposed amendments to the Code of the County of Fairfax, Appendix G, expanding the West Springfield RPPD, District 7, to include Fenwood Drive (Route 4181) from Roxbury Avenue to Oakford Drive. Vice-Chairman Smith seconded the motion and it carried by unanimous vote, Supervisor Alcorn, Supervisor Bierman, Supervisor Herrity, Supervisor Jimenez, Supervisor Lusk, Supervisor Palchik, Supervisor Storck, Vice-Chairman Smith and Chairman McKay voting “AYE.”
decisions.tally: Carried by unanimous vote, Supervisor Alcorn, Supervisor Bierman, Supervisor Herrity, Supervisor Jimenez, Supervisor Lusk, Supervisor Palchik, Supervisor Storck, Vice-Chairman Smith and Chairman McKay voting “AYE.”

decisions.item: 49. 4:30 P.m. – Public Hearing to Consider Adopting an Ordinance Establishing Parking Restrictions on South Street (MASON District)
decisions.action: Supervisor Jimenez moved adoption of the proposed amendments to the Code of the County of Fairfax, Appendix R, to prohibit parking of watercraft; boat trailers; motor homes; camping trailers; any other trailer or semi-trailer, on the south side of South Street, from Arlington Boulevard Service Road to the northeastern property line of 6430 Arlington Boulevard, at all times, as shown on Attachment One of the Board Agenda Item. The motion was multiply seconded and carried by unanimous vote, Supervisor Alcorn, Supervisor Bierman, Supervisor Herrity, Supervisor Jimenez, Supervisor Lusk, Supervisor Palchik, Supervisor Smith, Supervisor Storck, and Chairman McKay voting “AYE.”
decisions.tally: Carried by unanimous vote, Supervisor Alcorn, Supervisor Bierman, Supervisor Herrity, Supervisor Jimenez, Supervisor Lusk, Supervisor Palchik, Supervisor Smith, Supervisor Storck, and Chairman McKay voting “AYE.”
